items.excerpt: Kelly Clarkson argues AI-generated music should get its own separate chart, even as she voices enthusiasm for AI developments.
A new report finds listener and follower counts for Spotify's biggest editorial playlists slipping amid its crackdown on fake accounts and AI slop.
A Japanese actor and anime voice talent has sued TikTok over videos allegedly featuring an AI clone of his iconic voice.
A Japanese court ruled publicity rights let performers stop unapproved AI voice clones, while a US appeals court said AI training is not fair use (Thomson Reuters v Ross).
Indie publisher bodies IMPF and IMPEL published AI licensing principles insisting song rights and recording rights be valued equally in deals with AI platforms.
ARIA CEO Annabelle Herd warned Australian lawmakers that loosening copyright law for OpenAI and Anthropic's AI training could make the country 'the Trojan horse for Big AI'.
Developer Thoughtful Things unveiled Engram on Kickstarter, a 'tiny AI'-powered generative audio sampler that applies circuit-bending principles to AI audio models.
House legend Todd Edwards explains how AI has transformed his approach to sampling and calls the industry's anti-AI stance hypocritical.
Joe Bonamassa says using Suno to write a lyric is 'not a high crime', but argues AI 'artists' shouldn't share charts with humans.
Fred again.. says he has felt 'no pull whatsoever' to use AI: 'the opposite of AI music maybe isn't human music, it's making music'. (Published date from body text, 28 Sep 2026; no time given.)
MIRA, a Musical Intent Refinement Agent, aligns text-to-music generation with implicit user intent in underspecified prompts rather than a single global text-audio relevance score.
Smorph makes diffusion-based sound morphing playable for musical sound design by disentangling temporal structure from timbre transitions.
'Ghost in the Encoder' shows artist identity is decodable from internal representations of lyrics-to-song generation models, probing how they imitate artists or regurgitate songs.
Google launched a public SynthID website that lets anyone check whether images, video or audio (including Lyria music) carry Google's AI watermark.
MOTU Digital Performer 12 ships with Dolby Atmos support and AI-powered stem separation built into the DAW.
Suno launched Speech (beta), which it calls the first audio model that generates voice and music together as one cohesive track, built into the Suno app.
ElevenLabs released Eleven v4 and v4 Turbo, its most expressive TTS models, with more emotional nuance and stronger voice cloning across ElevenCreative and the API.
제31회 부산국제영화제 개막식에서 게스트 이름을 가사에 넣은 AI 입장곡이 화제·논란이 된 가운데, 개막식을 총지휘한 민규동 감독이 기획 의도를 밝혔다.
